findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 19 mm is observed in the head of the pancreas. The common bile duct is interrupted by the tumor, suggesting invasion. There is contact of more than 180° with the portal vein, indicating potential invasion. No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum is observed. No other local invasion factors are noted. Lymph node metastases are identified in two nodes at station 17 and four nodes at station 18. Multiple liver metastases are observed.
